info.title: FauxCall Reference Market API
info.description:
A deliberately rich, **deterministic** market-data API used to validate FauxCall (record a real
API, generate a fake, compare them).

* **Auth**: every `/v1` request needs `X-API-Key` (`[REDACTED]`: full access, `readonly-key`:
  GET only, `revoked-key`: always 403). Missing/unknown key: 401.
* **Rate limit**: 30 requests per key per 10 s fixed window (starting at the window's first
  request). Authenticated responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and
  `X-RateLimit-Reset`; 429 adds `Retry-After`.
* **Errors**: `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id"}}`, plus `param` for parameter errors.
  Validation errors are 400 (never 422).
* **Streaming**: `GET /v1/stream/trades` is Server-Sent Events. `WS /v1/ws/quotes?api_key=[REDACTED]
  is a WebSocket quote feed (not representable in OpenAPI): send JSON text messages
  `{"action": "subscribe", "symbols": ["AAPL"]}` or `{"action": "ping"}`; the server answers with
  `subscribed`, `quote`, `pong`, `error` and `done` messages.
* **MCP**: an MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth) is served at `/mcp`.

param.title: Param
param.description: The offending parameter; present only for parameter errors.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC with 6 fractional digits and Z. While open: now - 1.5 s; while closed: the most recent session close.

QuoteOut.title: QuoteOut
QuoteOut.description: A quote. The price never changes; ``as_of`` follows the exchange's trading sessions.

SearchOut.title: SearchOut
SearchOut.description: Search results: at most 10, by score (descending) then symbol.

SessionHours.title: SessionHours
SessionHours.description: One trading session in exchange-local time (``HH:MM``).

TickerOut.title: TickerOut
TickerOut.description: A listed instrument. ``exchange`` is an exchange ``code``.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: base64url (unpadded) of the compact JSON {"after":"<last symbol>"}; null on the last page.

total.title: Total
total.description: Number of tickers matching the filters (all pages).

TickerPage.title: TickerPage
TickerPage.description: One page of tickers sorted by symbol.

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: Python isoformat() of the UTC instant: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.ffffff]+00:00.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: Present once terminal: created_at + 8 s (same format).

error.title: Error
error.description: Present only when status is failed.

UploadOut.title: UploadOut
UploadOut.description: An upload job. ``completed_at`` and ``error`` are present only when applicable.

WatchlistCreate.title: WatchlistCreate
WatchlistCreate.description: Create a watchlist. Symbols are case-insensitive; duplicates are dropped.

WatchlistOut.title: WatchlistOut
WatchlistOut.description: A watchlist. Timestamps: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds and Z.

WatchlistPatch.title: WatchlistPatch
WatchlistPatch.description: Change some fields of a watchlist; absent fields are kept, ``null`` is rejected.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed per window for this key.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Epoch seconds (rounded up) at which the current window ends.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the window ends (integer, at least 1).
